column3: She accused her coworker of taking her notebook. (她指責同事拿了她的筆記本。)
The retail price of this jacket is too high. (這件外套的零售價格太高了。)
Milk will spoil quickly if you leave it out of the fridge. (如果你把牛奶放在冰箱外，它會很快變質。)
The new office building is currently under construction. (新的辦公大樓目前正在施工中。)
Please send your request for vacation days by Friday. (請在星期五之前送出您的休假申請。)
The company faced a lawsuit over unpaid bills. (該公司因未付帳款而面臨訴訟。)
The judge will sentence the criminal next week. (法官將於下週對罪犯進行判刑。)
Many celebrities attended the charity dinner last night. (許多名人昨晚出席了慈善晚宴。)
He felt guilty for missing his friend's birthday party. (他因為錯過朋友的生日派對而感到內疚。)
Our company decided to outsource customer service to reduce costs. (我們公司決定將客戶服務外包以降低成本。)
Bad weather caused major disruption to the flight schedules. (惡劣天氣對航班日程造成了嚴重干擾。)
She has worked in the corporate world for over ten years. (她在大企業領域工作了十多年。)
Police questioned a suspected shoplifter outside the store. (警方在店外詢問了一名涉嫌偷竊的人。)
The restaurant has a good reputation for fresh seafood. (這家餐廳在新鮮海鮮方面擁有良好的聲譽。)
Small businesses struggled to survive during the hard economic times. (在經濟困難時期，小企業努力求生存。)
